mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM writers WHERE email = #{email}) AS email_exists, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM writers WHERE username = #{username}) AS username_exists
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO writers ( images_id, name, email, username, about, phone_no, website ) VALUES ( #{imagesId}, #{name}, #{email}, #{username}, #{about}, #{phoneNo}, #{website} )
mapper.update: UPDATE writers SET images_id = #{imagesId}, name = #{name}, email = #{email}, username = #{username}, about = #{about}, phone_no = #{phoneNo}, website = #{website} WHERE id = #{writersId}
mapper.delete: UPDATE writers SET deleted = TRUE WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM writers WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted IS FALSE
SELECT * FROM writers WHERE deleted IS FALSE ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM writers WHERE id = #{writers_id} AND deleted IS FALSE
